match.eventName: ESL Challenger League Season 51 North America Finals

matchData.information:
Best of 5 (Online)

* Grand final. Winner qualifies for ESL Pro League Season 24.
matchData.veto:
1. Voca removed Inferno
2. M80 removed Nuke
3. Voca picked Dust2
4. M80 picked Anubis
5. Voca picked Ancient
6. M80 picked Mirage
7. Overpass was left over
